title: JavaScript
tagline: Understand the language, runtime, and systems built on JavaScript
summary: JavaScript is a dynamic programming language whose behavior is defined by the ECMAScript language specification and extended by host environments such as browsers and Node.js. This book builds a precise mental model from values, objects, functions, scope, execution contexts, prototypes, coercion, modules, asynchronous programming, promises, the event loop, memory, errors, browser APIs, workers, security, performance, and application architecture. The goal is not to memorize syntax, but to understand what JavaScript is doing and why real programs behave the way they do.
